info.title: CosmicForge Community Health System API
info.description: Phase 1: Communities, Membership & Roles, and Posts. Phase 2: Events. Phase 3: Group Chat — every community automatically gets a group chat room (Community.chatRoomId), kept in sync with membership, usable via the endpoints under the Group Chat tag below (these are the same underlying /api/chat/* endpoints the rest of the platform uses for appointment/direct chat too — {roomId} in every path is the community's chatRoomId). Phase 4: Voice Spaces — audio-only, Twitter/X-Spaces-style rooms backed by real Zoom meetings (any active member can start one; one live space per community at a time). Host controls (mute/remove) happen in Zoom's own in-meeting UI via the host's start link, not via this API — the account backing this integration is on a plan without per-participant REST moderation. Invite Members — any active member can search the platform's users and invite them directly (no join request needed); the invitee accepts/declines from their own inbox. Cross-community feeds — GET /posts/feed and GET /events/feed aggregate posts/upcoming events across every community the caller belongs to. Leaving — any member, including the owner, can leave a community; if the owner leaves, ownership auto-transfers to another active member (or the community closes if they were the last one). A social/networking layer shared across doctors, patients, pharmacies, and labs — same architecture for every role, only role/permissions differ. Community roles (owner/admin/moderator/member/pending_member) are per-community and separate from the platform-wide user role.

tags.name: Communities
tags.description: Create, discover, update, and delete communities

tags.name: Membership
tags.description: Join/leave, join-requests, member list, remove/promote members. Also keeps each member's group-chat access in sync (see Community.chatRoomId).

tags.name: Events
tags.description: Community events: create/publish/update/delete, RSVP, reminders, attendee list

tags.name: Voice Spaces
tags.description: Audio-only live rooms: start/end, join/leave, request-to-speak, promote/demote, attendee list

tags.name: Invites
tags.description: Invite a friend to the community: search/suggest platform users, send/cancel invites, and the invitee's accept/decline inbox. Only one pending invite per (community, invitee) at a time.

tags.name: Group Chat
tags.description: Real-time messaging in a community's chat room ({roomId} = Community.chatRoomId). These are the shared platform chat endpoints (also used for appointment/direct chat) — full generic docs at the main /api-docs. Real-time delivery also available via socket.io events (join_room, send_message, typing_start, etc.) on the same connection.

post.description: Creates the community and makes the caller its owner.

get.description: Communities the caller is an active member of, each annotated with the caller's role (myRole).
Public discovery feed. Excludes communities the caller already belongs to.
Response includes isMember, myRole, and hasPendingRequest flags for the caller.

delete.description: Owner only. Soft delete — the community is hidden from discovery/joins but its data is preserved.

post.description: Instant join. Returns 400 if the community is private — use the join-requests endpoint instead.

post.summary: Request to join a private community
post.description: Notifies the community's owners/admins. Returns 400 if the community is public, already a member, or a pending request already exists.

message.example: I'd love to join this community

get.description: Owner/admin only.

post.description: Owner/admin only. Activates the requester's membership and notifies them.
Owner/admin only. Notifies the requester.

Any member can leave, including the owner. If the owner leaves, ownership is automatically transferred to another active member (preferring an existing admin, then moderator, then the longest-standing plain member) and that member is notified. If the owner is the community's last active member, the community is closed (soft-deleted) instead.

communityDeleted.description: True if the community was closed because the owner was its last active member

get.description: Any active member can view.

delete.description: Owner/admin only. The owner cannot be removed this way, and you cannot remove yourself (use leave instead).

put.description: Owner only. newRole must be one of admin/moderator/member — ownership itself is not transferable through this endpoint.

post.description: Requires active membership (any role). A post needs content and/or at least one media URL.

get.description: Requires active membership (any role).

get.summary: List posts from all communities I've joined
get.description: A combined, reverse-chronological feed of posts across every community the caller is an active member of. Each post includes a community reference so the client can tell them apart.
Increments the view count and returns isLiked/isSaved flags for the caller.

delete.description: The author, or a moderator/admin/owner of the post's community, can delete it.

post.description: Set parentCommentId to reply to another comment (one level of threading).

delete.description: The author, or a moderator/admin/owner of the post's community, can delete it.

get.summary: List upcoming events from all communities I've joined
get.description: Published, upcoming (startAt in the future) events across every community the caller is an active member of, soonest first. Each event includes a community reference so the client can tell them apart.

post.description: Owner/admin only. Set status to "published" to publish immediately (notifies all other active members) or omit/"draft" to save as a draft first.

get.description: Draft events are only included for owners/admins; everyone else sees published events only.
Draft events are only visible to the community's owner/admin. Response includes isGoing/remindMe flags for the caller.

put.description: Owner/admin only. Setting status from draft to published notifies all other active community members.

post.description: Confirms attendance ("going"). The event must be published. Reminder defaults to on.

put.summary: Set/unset the reminder for an event
put.description: Requires an existing RSVP — RSVP first, then toggle the reminder. A background job notifies remindMe=true attendees roughly 1 hour before the event starts.

get.description: Owner/admin only.

post.description: Any active member can start one. Creates a real, instant Zoom meeting. Fails with 400 if the community already has a live space (only one at a time). The response includes joinUrl (share with anyone) and hostStartUrl (host only — never shown to other viewers).

get.summary: Get the community's current live voice space, if any
get.description: Returns 404 if no space is currently live.

404.description: No live voice space in this community

get.summary: Get a voice space by ID
get.description: Response includes myRole and handRaised for the caller (null/false if not an active participant).

post.description: Host only. Really ends the underlying Zoom meeting, marks the space ended, and disconnects all participants.
Joins as a listener. Requires active community membership and a live space.
If the host leaves, the space automatically ends for everyone.

post.summary: Raise your hand to request to speak
post.description: Listeners only. Notifies the host.
Host only.

post.summary: Move a speaker back to listener ("Remove speakers")
post.description: Host only.

get.description: Requires active membership (any role). Matches on name/email, excludes the caller and anyone already an active member of this community.
Requires active membership (any role). Suggests users who share at least one other active community with the caller and aren't already members of this one.

post.description: Requires active membership (any role). Fails with 400 if inviting yourself, the invitee is already an active member, or the invitee already has a pending invite to this community. Notifies the invitee.

get.summary: List invites sent by this community
get.description: Owner/admin only.

delete.description: The original sender, or a community owner/admin, can cancel. Fails with 404 if the invite doesn't exist or is no longer pending.

post.description: Only the invitee can accept. Creates (or reactivates) the invitee's community membership with invitedBy set, syncs their group-chat access, and notifies the original sender. Fails with 404 if the invite doesn't exist or is no longer pending.
Only the invitee can decline. Fails with 404 if the invite doesn't exist or is no longer pending.

roomId = the community's chatRoomId.

roomId = the community's chatRoomId. Omit messageId to mark the whole room read.

parameters.name: soft
parameters.description: Soft-delete (default) keeps the row marked deleted; false hard-deletes it.

PublicUser.description: A stripped-down user reference — never includes credentials or contact fields.

chatRoomId.description: The community's group chat room. Every active member is automatically kept in sync as a participant of this room (owner/admin → chat role 'admin', moderator → 'moderator', member → 'member'). Use the existing generic chat API (documented at /api-docs) to send/read messages: POST/GET /api/chat/rooms/{chatRoomId}/messages, GET /api/chat/rooms/{chatRoomId}, plus the socket.io events (join_room, send_message, typing_start, etc.). There are no community-specific chat endpoints — community membership alone grants access.

isMember.description: Present on GET /communities/{id} — whether the caller is an active member

hasPendingRequest.description: Present on GET /communities/{id} — caller has a pending join request

content.example: Hello everyone, glad to be here!

isLiked.description: Present on GET /posts/{id} — whether the caller liked this post

isSaved.description: Present on GET /posts/{id} — whether the caller saved this post

parentCommentId.description: Set to reply to another comment

status.description: Omit or "draft" to save as a draft; "published" to publish immediately.
Set to "published" to publish a draft event.

isGoing.description: Present on GET /events/{id} — whether the caller has RSVP'd

remindMe.description: Present on GET /events/{id} — the caller's reminder preference (false if not RSVP'd)

joinUrl.description: Share with anyone who wants to join the audio room

hostStartUrl.description: HOST ONLY — launches the Zoom meeting with full moderator control (mute/remove). Omitted entirely for every other viewer.

role.description: Chat-level role, synced from the community role (owner→admin, moderator→moderator, member→member)

replyTo.description: The message this one replies to, if any
